verdict.rationale: Installing community-contributed integrations is a fair question for a workflow and automation platform like Windmill, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes a community hub, marketplace, or way to install third-party scripts, nodes, or integrations. The evidence covers only first-party features (languages, flows, CLI, Git sync, MCP), plus one community comment calling the model "open and extensible" without naming any community-contributed integrations.
